name: templates-analytics-dashboard
title: Analytics Dashboard
description: A starting-point application dashboard example built with Tailwind CSS, combining a sidebar, topbar, stat cards, revenue and order charts, and a data table into a single page. Not a production-ready template.
useWhen: Starting a simple analytics dashboard that combines navigation, key metrics, charts, and a records table.
Prototyping an internal reporting interface with the library’s existing application components.
avoidWhen: Shipping a production dashboard without connecting real data, authentication, loading states, and error handling.
Building a non-analytic workflow that does not need metrics or chart-driven summaries.
responsiveBehavior: The sidebar becomes a mobile drawer or collapsible navigation. Metric cards and charts reflow into a single-column dashboard while tables retain a deliberate overflow strategy.
accessibility: Provide a text or table alternative for every chart.
Use landmarks for sidebar, header, and main content, and give every table a caption or accessible name.
